bestBets.overview: ZWEIGELT looks ideally placed now to break the maiden. Returned in decent order on heavy conditions after a long lay off, will appreciate getting back onto drier ground, strips fitter and expect plenty of improvement here. LA REGINA should be rock hard fit now after plenty of racing, looks to be getting better with each run and is a genuine contender in this field. SORRENTI looks ideally drawn from barrier 3, looks ready to hit peak fitness 3rd up and will look to settle in behind the leader before running on strongly. IN BOCCA AL LUPE draws the inside gate and looks to be the likely leader of the field. He won?t have to do any work to find the lead and can be in this for a long way.

raceTips.comment: Sorrenti has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited by the race setup, with the pace expected to allow the mare to settle just off the leaders before producing a sustained finish. Zweigell has been racing consistently and should appreciate the opportunity to settle closer from the favourable draw, giving every indication of being competitive when the pressure goes on. La Regina has the racing experience to handle this assignment and can improve with a more economical run in transit, particularly if able to find cover behind the speed. Birdy Girl has shown glimpses of staying power and looks capable of making her presence felt late, with a controlled tempo likely to suit her finishing effort.

bestBets.overview: Looks to be a quite competitive race here. Happy to have RUM AND KIRK on top who looks to get the gun run from the inside draw. He has plenty of gate speed and expect he will roll forward and may even look to lead throughout. Strips fitter 3rd up and looks a genuine contender. Liked the recent trial of FLYING MONARCH, showed signs of maturity and looks ready to debut now. Expect a strong showing. INSAIN CHAOS gets the benefit of 1.5kg for his resumption after 33 weeks away from race day. Has always shown some ability and has had early market support here. PEARL PENDANT looks to be a likely improver 2nd up.

raceTips.comment: Rum And Kirk hit the line strongly over 1100m two starts back and is now at peak fitness third up this preparation,  maps to enjoy the run of the race stalking the leading pair throughout and saved for one sprint at them late. Kobi Express is ready to peak this preparation and has the superior early speed to find the front to dictate the tempo to suit. Pearl Pendant would have taken considerable improvement off the fresh performance and from barrier 2 will enjoy a soft run throughout.

bestBets.overview: SUNSET ADIOS hit the line strongly last start at Ipswich. Looks better suited here in a country maiden. Nice trial since that run and looks to still have plenty of scope for improvement. LONG LIVE is ready to peak now 3rd up, stormed home for 2nd last start and can only continue improve off that run. May need a little bit of luck from the wide draw, but looks good enough to win this. RUBINSKY has always showed plenty of talent, resumes here after 26 weeks, quiet trial leading in will have her ready to go. POINTY END deserves consideration in this field.

raceTips.comment: Long Live looks well placed on recent form and should have the tactical speed to settle in a prominent position without doing too much work early. Pointy End has been holding his form together well and should enjoy a soft run behind the leaders, giving him every chance to be in the finish when balanced up. Sunset Adios has the ability to travel comfortably and possesses enough finishing speed to threaten the main chances if the race is run at a genuine tempo. Funky Cold Medina is another capable runner who can improve with the right run in transit, and his best efforts suggest he has the turn of foot required to make an impact late.

A TOUCH FROM FAYT has been mixing her form of late , but did put in a strong effort last start to salute. If she can find her best again, she can be in the finish. FLYING SHELLY and PATRIOTICINTENTION look to be next best chances.

raceTips.comment: Jeweis Statement has continued to race honestly and should get every opportunity from the draw, with a patient ride allowing the mare to conserve energy for the final stages. A Touch From Fayt has enough natural ability to be competitive here and can settle just behind the speed, where a clear passage will be important when the pressure increases. Golden Copper has shown he can finish his races off strongly and should be kept safe if able to find cover and produce his best late.

bestBets.overview: RICH STAR looks to be a progressive type after putting together three straight wins last prep. Was strong on speed first up and is a proven second up performer. Gets the benefit of the claim and looks a genuine chance. HUMPHREE BEAR looks suited coming back to his preferred trip after a strong effort at Grafton last start. Should get a nice run just behind the speed and expect he can be hitting the line strongly. TRYANZA has been thereabouts of late and was strong through the heavy going last start. Can contend here. THE ROOKIE has been a little inconsistent but gets in nicely at the weights and can be competitive.

raceTips.comment: Rich Star has been racing in good touch and looks ideally suited to this type of contest, with the gelding capable of rolling forward and finding a position that allows him to dictate his own race. Tryanza has plenty of race experience and should appreciate a genuine tempo, with her ability to sustain a long run giving her a strong chance of being competitive late. Humphree Bear has shown enough speed and toughness to make his presence felt, and a clean run through the middle stages should bring him into calculations when the field straightens. Soho Artist possesses a sharp finishing burst and can be dangerous if saved for one run, particularly if the leaders overdo the early work.

bestBets.overview: VENOM WOLF was a strong winner two starts back, before being ridden cold and never in the mix last start. Expecting a more positive ride here and to bounce back. ZUCCHERO has drawn the inside gate and should be rock hard fit. Can be in the numbers. ARTIE LADY can be an improver 3rd up, she was ridden cold last start and got too far back to mount a serious challenge. Expect a more positive ride here. AUSBRED YAHOO gets in well at the weights and with a good barrier, she can be an improver.

raceTips.comment: Venom Wolf has been competitive without having everything go his way and can settle closer than usual, which could prove valuable if the tempo allows those near the speed to gain an advantage. Releasethewolves has enough ability to figure prominently and should be suited by a strong gallop, with his finishing strength likely to come into play over the latter stages. Zucchero is an interesting runner who can improve with the right conditions, and his ability to quicken off a steady tempo makes him a genuine chance.

bestBets.overview: I AM VOODOO continues to race in good order and was dominant getting the job done as favourite at Gympie last start. Gets in nicely here with the 4kg claim and should get every chance throughout. Been a little while since we have seen COOL FIZZ at his best, maybe the short 808m can have him competing at the finish line. CLOSE TO MIDNIGHT looks ready to peak now fourth up, has plenty of gate speed, which you will need over this trip. CITY OF TEARS looks next best.

raceTips.comment: I Am Voodoo has been putting together some encouraging performances and looks capable of settling in a favourable position, with the gelding possessing enough acceleration to take advantage when the race opens up. City Of Tears has a good racing pattern and should be able to find cover close to the speed, giving the mare every opportunity to conserve energy for the final stages. Close To Midnight has shown the ability to finish strongly and can become a factor if the leaders are pressured throughout, with a clear passage expected to be important. Cool Fizz has the talent to run well in this company and can settle midfield before producing a sustained effort, making the runner worth including in the main chances.
